description: Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology is an open data portal listed in Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology. Coverage: Europe. The European data portal lists 727 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 19 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 5 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-cnect.
